en: I'd swap my Mr. Mime for an Abra. Would you trade one with me?
An Abra at last! Thank you. Please look after Mimien for me.
That isn't an Abra. It's an Abra I'm after.
That's all right. If you ever catch an Abra, come and find me.
Abra and I are the best of friends already. I hope Mimien is happy with you.
